license_required.quote: No person shall act as or hold himself out to be an insurance producer unless licensed by the Department of Insurance.

issuing_authority.value: Department of Insurance / Commissioner of Insurance
issuing_authority.quote: A person applying for a resident insurance producer license shall make application to the commissioner of insurance

name.quote: No person shall act as or hold himself out to be an insurance producer unless licensed by the Department of Insurance.

type.quote: A person applying for a resident insurance producer license shall make application to the commissioner of insurance on the Uniform Application

age_minimum.quote: Is at least eighteen years of age.

moral_character_required.quote: Is not disqualified for having committed any act that is a ground for denial, suspension, or revocation as set forth in R.S. 22:1554.

required.quote: Prior to the issuance of a license by the commissioner, a resident individual shall pass an examination for each line of insurance that an applicant seeks to transact in Louisiana unless exempt pursuant to R.S. 22:1551.

experience_source.quote: Prior to the issuance of a license by the commissioner, a resident individual shall pass an examination for each line of insurance that an applicant seeks to transact in Louisiana unless exempt pursuant to R.S. 22:1551.

exams.name: Insurance Producer Licensing Examination
exams.notes: Must achieve a score of at least seventy percent. Exemptions available under RS 22:1551.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered under rules prescribed by the commissioner; commissioner may contract with private testing services)
exams.quote: a resident individual shall pass an examination for each line of insurance that an applicant seeks to transact in Louisiana unless exempt pursuant to R.S. 22:1551. The applicant shall pass the examination if he achieves a score of at least seventy percent.

interval_years.quote: Every licensed producer shall file an application for renewal of his license every two years

required.quote: Prior to the filing date for application for renewal of a license, the licensee shall comply with continuing education requirements in R.S. 22:1573 for the lines of insurance being renewed.

hours_per_period.quote: Life insurance producers and consultants and accident and health or sickness insurance producers and consultants shall complete twenty-four hours of approved instruction or verifiable approved self-study prior to each renewal of license

period_years.quote: Every licensed producer shall file an application for renewal of his license every two years

value: flood insurance (at least 3 hours, for property/casualty producers)
legislative updates in insurance law (at least 2 hours, for combination license holders)
topical_requirements.quote: with at least three hours dedicated to the subject of ethics. ... with at least three hours dedicated to the subject of flood insurance. ... at least two hours dedicated to the subject of legislative updates in insurance law.

available.quote: The commissioner of insurance shall waive any requirements for a nonresident license applicant with a valid license from his home state, except the requirements imposed by R.S. 22:1548, if the applicant's home state awards nonresident licenses to residents of this state on the same basis.

requirements.value: Nonresident must be currently licensed and in good standing in home state, submit proper application and fees, and home state must award nonresident licenses to Louisiana residents on the same basis (reciprocity). Commissioner may verify status through NAIC producer database.
requirements.quote: a nonresident person shall receive a nonresident producer license if: (1) The person is currently licensed as a resident and in good standing in his home state. (2) The person has submitted the proper request for licensure and has paid the fees required by R.S. 22:821. ... (4) The person's home state awards nonresident producer licenses to residents of this state on the same basis.

exists.quote: This Subpart shall govern the qualifications and procedures for the licensing of insurance producers.

national_association.quote: the commissioner may contract with nongovernmental entities, including the National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) or any affiliates or subsidiaries that the NAIC oversees, to perform any ministerial functions, including the collection of fees, related to producer licensing

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall act as or hold himself out to be an insurance producer unless licensed by the Department of Insurance.

credential_type.quote: "License" shall mean a document issued by this state's commissioner of insurance authorizing a person to act as an insurance producer for the lines of authority specified in the document.

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall act as or hold himself out to be an insurance producer unless licensed by the Department of Insurance.

title_protection.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person or business entity, without conforming to the provisions of this Part, directly or indirectly, to represent himself or itself to be an insurance producer or limited lines producer

scope_protection.quote: No person shall act as or hold himself out to be an insurance producer unless licensed by the Department of Insurance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with any prerequisite of state or federal law or regulations for the issuance of such license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to comply with any prerequisite of state or federal law or regulations for the issuance of such license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing incorrect, misleading, incomplete, or materially false information, or omission of material information, in the license or renewal application.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing incorrect, misleading, incomplete, or materially false information, or omission of material information, in the license or renewal application.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to account for or remit any premiums, monies, or properties belonging to another, or misappropriating funds received in the course of doing insurance business.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to account for or remit any premiums, monies, or properties belonging to another which come into the possession of the applicant in the course of doing insurance business, or improperly withholding, misappropriating, converting, or failing to timely remit any premiums, monies, or properties received in the course of doing insurance business

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using fraudulent, coercive, or dishonest practices or misrepresentation, or demonstrating incompetence, untrustworthiness, or financial irresponsibility.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using fraudulent, coercive, or dishonest practices or misrepresentation, or demonstrating incompetence, untrustworthiness, or financial irresponsibility in the conduct of business such as might endanger the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresenting the terms of an actual or proposed insurance contract, binder, rider, plan, or application for insurance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresenting the terms of an actual or proposed insurance contract, binder, rider, plan, or application for insurance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having admitted or been found to have committed any insurance unfair trade practice or fraud.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having admitted or been found to have committed any insurance unfair trade practice under R.S. 22:1961 et seq. or fraud under R.S. 22:1964 et seq.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction or nolo contendere plea to any felony, or conviction of any misdemeanor involving moral turpitude or public corruption.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The conviction or nolo contendere plea to any felony, participation in a pretrial diversion program pursuant to a felony charge, suspension and deferral of sentence and probation pursuant to Code of Criminal Procedure Article 893, or conviction of any misdemeanor involving moral turpitude or public corruption.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a license through misrepresentation or fraud, or cheating on an examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a license through misrepresentation or fraud, or improperly using notes or any other reference material to complete an examination for an insurance license, or otherwise cheating or attempting to cheat on an examination for an insurance license of any kind.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudication of bankruptcy with debts related to the receipt or transmittal of insurance premiums or other funds in a fiduciary capacity.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The adjudication of bankruptcy with debts related to the receipt or transmittal of insurance premiums or other funds to an insurer or insured in any fiduciary capacity of the applicant, or issuance to the Department of Insurance of an insufficient fund or no-fund check.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Forging another's name to an application for insurance or to any document related to an insurance transaction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Forging another's name to an application for insurance or to any document related to an insurance transaction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly accepting insurance business from a person who is not licensed as a producer.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly accepting insurance business from a person who is not licensed as a producer.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procurement of a license for the purpose of writing controlled business.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The procurement of a license for the purpose of writing controlled business, as prohibited in this Subpart.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having an insurance producer license denied, suspended, or revoked in this or any other state, province, district, or territory.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having an insurance producer license, or its equivalent, denied, suspended, or revoked in this or any other state, province, district, or territory.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any insurance laws of the United States, this state or any state, province, district, or territory, or any lawful rule, regulation, subpoena, or order of the commissioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The violation of any insurance laws of the United States, this state or any state, province, district, or territory, or violating any lawful rule, regulation, subpoena, or order of the commissioner of insurance or of the insurance officials of another state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with an administrative or court order imposing a child support obligation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to comply with an administrative or court order imposing a child support obligation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay state income taxes or comply with any administrative or court order directing payment of state income taxes.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure to pay state income taxes or comply with any administrative or court order directing payment of state income taxes.

disciplinary_grounds.description: A producer, without commissioner consent, employing or associating with any person engaged in the business of insurance who has been convicted of a felony.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A producer, without the consent of or a waiver from the commissioner, has employed or has allowed to associate with his business, in any manner, any person engaged in the business of insurance who has been convicted of a felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony involving dishonesty or breach of trust pursuant to 18 U.S.C. 1033 and 1034 without written consent from the commissioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The conviction of a felony involving dishonesty or breach of trust pursuant to 18 U.S.C. 1033 and 1034, without written consent from the commissioner of insurance pursuant to 18 U.S.C. 1033

disciplinary_grounds.description: If the producer is a business entity, refusal to remove or discharge any registered person who has been convicted or pleaded nolo contendere to any felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If the producer is a business entity, refusal to remove or discharge any person registered pursuant to R.S. 22:1546(B) who has been convicted or pleaded nolo contendere to any felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: If the producer is a business entity, refusal to remove or discharge any registered person who has had an insurance producer license revoked or suspended or is found to have violated any provision of this Code.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If the producer is a business entity, refusal to remove or discharge any person registered pursuant to R.S. 22:1546(B) who has had an insurance producer license revoked or suspended or is found to have violated any provision of this Code.

insurance_required.quote: Every insurance producer who is actively writing insurance policies in this state and is subject to the provisions of R.S. 22:1570 shall maintain professional liability insurance or an errors and omissions policy

definition_quote.value: "Insurance producer" or "producer" shall mean a person required to be licensed under the laws of this state to sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance, and includes all persons or business entities otherwise referred to in this Code as "insurance agent" or "agent", or "insurance broker" or "broker", or "insurance solicitor" or "solicitor", or "surplus lines broker".
definition_quote.quote: "Insurance producer" or "producer" shall mean a person required to be licensed under the laws of this state to sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance, and includes all persons or business entities otherwise referred to in this Code as "insurance agent" or "agent", or "insurance broker" or "broker", or "insurance solicitor" or "solicitor", or "surplus lines broker".

methods_authorized.quote: "Sell" shall mean to exchange a contract of insurance by any means, for money or its equivalent, on behalf of an insurer. "Solicit" shall mean to attempt to sell insurance or to ask or urge a person to apply for a particular kind of insurance from a particular insurer. "Negotiate" shall mean to confer directly with or to offer advice directly to a purchaser

approximate.matched_normalized: sell shall mean to exchange a contract of insurance by any means for money or its equivalent on behalf of an insurer solicit shall mean to attempt to sell insurance or to ask or urge a person to apply for a particular kind of insurance from a particular insurer

value: Any other line of insurance permitted under state laws or regulations
lines_of_authority.quote: An insurance producer may receive qualification for a license in one or more of the following lines of authority: (1) Life ... (2) Accident and health or sickness ... (3) Variable life and variable annuity. (4) Property ... (5) Casualty ... (6) Personal lines ... (7) Title. (8) Credit ... (9) Travel insurance ... (10) Limited life, health and accident ... (11) Industrial fire. (12) Surety ... (13) Bail bonds. (14) Surplus lines ... (15) Any other line of insurance permitted under state laws or regulations.

resident_license_available.quote: A person applying for a resident insurance producer license shall make application to the commissioner of insurance on the Uniform Application

nonresident_license_available.quote: Unless denied licensure pursuant to R.S. 22:1554, a nonresident person shall receive a nonresident producer license if:

business_entity_license_available.quote: A business entity acting as an insurance producer shall obtain an insurance producer license.

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: The business entity has designated one or more licensed individual producers responsible for the business entity's compliance with the insurance laws, rules, and regulations of this state.

temporary_license_available.quote: The commissioner of insurance may issue a temporary insurance producer license for a period not to exceed one hundred eighty days without requiring an examination

temporary_license_max_days.quote: The commissioner of insurance may issue a temporary insurance producer license for a period not to exceed one hundred eighty days without requiring an examination

appointment_required_to_represent_insure.quote: An insurance producer shall not act as an agent of an insurer unless the insurance producer becomes an appointed agent of that insurer

appointment_fee.value: Fees set forth in R.S. 22:821 (amount set by rule)
appointment_fee.quote: Each insurer shall remit, in a manner prescribed by the commissioner, appointment fees in the amounts set forth in R.S. 22:821.

appointment_termination_reporting_days.quote: An insurer or authorized representative of the insurer that terminates the appointment, employment, or contract with a producer for any reason not set forth in R.S. 22:1554, shall notify the commissioner of insurance within thirty days following the effective date of the termination

additional_fee_for_commercial_business_a.quote: an insurance producer may negotiate with both or either a property and casualty insurer or a commercial policyholder ... to compensate the insurance producer for the placement of commercial property and casualty insurance coverages by any combination of commissions, fees, or fees in lieu of commissions

misconduct_reporting_to_department_days.quote: An insurance producer shall report to the commissioner of insurance any administrative action taken against the producer in another jurisdiction or by another governmental agency in this state within thirty days of the final disposition of the matter.

naic_producer_database_used_for_verifica.quote: The commissioner of insurance may verify the producer's licensing status through the producer database maintained by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners, its affiliates, or subsidiaries.

home_state_change_application_window_day.quote: A person licensed as an insurance producer in another state who moves to this state shall make application within ninety days of establishing legal residence to become a resident licensee pursuant to R.S. 22:1546.

lapsed_license_reinstatement_window_days.quote: An insurance producer who allows his license to lapse may, within two years from the expiration date of the license, reinstate the same license upon proof of fulfilling all continuing education requirements through the date of reinstatement and upon payment of all fees due.

fingerprint_submission_required.quote: The commissioner shall require each applicant to submit a full set of fingerprints in order for the commissioner to obtain and receive National Criminal History Records from the FBI Criminal Justice Information Services Division.
